questions.question: What did the prophet Hananiah falsely proclaim in chapter 28?
options: That God would break Babylon's yoke within two years
That a great famine would soon sweep across all of Judah
That war would ravage the land for ten long years
That the exile would last for many generations
questions.answer: That God would break Babylon's yoke within two years

questions.question: What happened to Hananiah for his false prophecy?
options: He died that same year, as Jeremiah foretold
He fled into exile and was never once seen again
He repented and became a true prophet
He was made a leader among the prophets
questions.answer: He died that same year, as Jeremiah foretold

questions.question: Hananiah took the wooden yoke-bar from Jeremiah's neck and broke it.
Jeremiah said God would replace the wooden yoke with a yoke of _____.
In that same year, in the seventh month, the prophet _____ died.
